proposed_widenings.name: modify_movement
proposed_widenings.justification: Jump's core mechanic is a timed movement enhancement: the target can jump up to 30 ft by spending only 10 ft of movement on each of its turns. OngoingOperation only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit — neither captures movement modification. A new variant is needed (e.g. modify_movement or grant_jump) to express this shape as an ongoing operation under the ongoing_effect family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once on each of its turns until the spell ends, that creature can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

notes: The spell otherwise fits ongoing_effect cleanly: bonus_action casting time, touch range, timed 1-minute non-concentration duration, single-target attachment scalable with slot level (one additional creature per slot above 1, matching the SlotScaling<number> shape used by Bless). The v4 taxonomy includes modify_speed as an effect atom; jump distance modification may map to that atom or require a finer-grained atom (modify_jump_distance) since jump is mechanically distinct from walking/flying/swimming speed.
